design_intent: The Authority Nexus on the destination galaxy side continuously stabilizes the wormhole. Destruction of its containment machinery causes the wormhole to collapse and disappear.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: revised 2D game concept art for Stellar Syndicates.
Input image: the selected AUTHORITY NEXUS concept, the design to preserve and develop.

CORE DESIGN IDEA: this station is the active wormhole anchor on the newly reached galaxy's side. Its machinery continuously expends energy to hold an otherwise collapsing wormhole open. Destroying this local station would shut down the field and the wormhole would vanish. The architecture should visually explain this dependency without relying on explanatory text. This image shows the intact station, fully powered and operating normally.

PRESERVE: the reference's elegant monumental Art Deco identity; ivory titanium and pale ceramic armor, brushed brass ribs, graphite structure, restrained amber windows; broad concentric terraced disk, glass-fronted port halls, recessed freight docks and loading terraces; the large open horizontal violet wormhole. Preserve the FOUR existing fluted architectural pylons at rear, left, right and foreground. Retain their positions and overall sculptural shapes, and the same elevated three-quarter camera. Refine their purpose rather than replacing the architecture.

DESIGN CHANGES:
1. Turn all FOUR sculptural pylons into clearly functional gravitational stabilizers. Their fluted ivory shells frame visible recessed stacks of brass magnetic focusing coils around a luminous cyan-white vertical power spine. Make the nested machinery and insulated armored mounting points legible. The pylons are powerful machines integrated into dignified civic architecture, not guns or decorative obelisks.
2. From each pylon base, route one broad, visibly engineered armored power conduit across its radial terrace toward the inner ring. Each conduit has repeated brass couplings and inset cyan segments. The four paths clearly connect stabilizers to containment emitters. Keep the glowing paths embedded in physical machinery, not graphics painted over the picture.
3. Make the inner containment collar an independently legible segmented machine inside the commercial terraces. Add large repeated emitter blocks, heavy induction coils, coolant plumbing, and heat-sink fins. Four larger inward-facing anchor emitters align with the four pylons. Their short forked metal jaws stop at the edge of the aperture, leaving the transit center entirely unobstructed.
4. Show four short controlled cyan-violet FIELD TETHERS linking those anchor emitter tips to the nearest section of the wormhole's circumference. They should look like concentrated curved magnetic field ribbons gently pulling the rim outward and holding it open, NOT weapon beams, giant lightning bolts, long rays crossing the center, or a cage over the passage. The violet rim is locally taut and brighter at these four anchor points; the dark swirling throat remains clearly visible and free to traverse. The portal is entirely an energy phenomenon, never a solid floor or mechanical iris.
5. Under the terraces, reveal a few dark radiator panels and massive power-plant housings supporting the containment system. Retain the cargo identity; do not turn the whole station into a weapon.

VISUAL STORY: there is one obvious physical chain, power plant -> stabilizer pylons -> glowing armored feeds -> inner-ring emitters -> tensioned wormhole edge. With those lights and field tethers gone, the portal would no longer exist. Do not depict any remote station, second gateway, battles, or destruction in this intact concept.

COMPOSITION / FINISH: one complete intact hub, fully visible with safe margins including all pylon tips. Landscape 3:2, light neutral gray studio background with no ground plane, no scenery. Same rich fine material detail and believable hard-surface digital concept painting as the supplied image. Soft upper-left light, crisp large shapes, restrained emission so hardware stays readable. Do not add ships, people, planets, stars, scale figures, logos, target markers, interface or callout arrows.
Only text, small and centered beneath the station, exactly: "AUTHORITY NEXUS — WORMHOLE ANCHOR".

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a three-state 2D game concept sheet explaining how destroying an Authority Nexus closes its wormhole.
Input image is the approved intact AUTHORITY NEXUS WORMHOLE ANCHOR design. Use this exact station, its four fluted ivory-and-brass stabilizer pylons with exposed cyan coils, layered port terraces, glass halls, cargo docks, four armored glowing power feeds and segmented inner containment ring.

FORMAT: true 3:1 landscape comparison sheet. Three equal-size views in one horizontal row, on the same quiet light-gray background as the reference. Same elevated three-quarter camera, same scale and same orientation for all three. Each complete station silhouette stays inside its panel with clear gaps and full safe margins. Present a coherent chronological sequence, not three redesigns. No arrows or overlay diagrams. Small title across top, exactly "AUTHORITY NEXUS — CONTAINMENT STATES". Three short clear charcoal labels centered below the respective stations, exactly "OPEN", "COLLAPSING", "CLOSED".

LEFT — OPEN: the intact station exactly as the input. Four bright cyan coil pylons, intact illuminated power feeds, functioning inner-ring emitters. Four short cyan-violet field tethers grip a stable full-width violet swirling wormhole at the rim. The center is a dark traversable throat. This is a machine continuously holding the passage open.

MIDDLE — COLLAPSING: same station geometry and perspective but clear structural damage to two pylons and an associated section of the inner ring. A snapped pylon exposes dark machinery, a severed power conduit has gone dark, one emitter segment is missing or tilted. Remaining stabilizers struggle visibly: only two emitters remain faintly active, their field ribbons lose contact with the portal edge. The wormhole has SHRUNK to HALF its original diameter and is irregular, scalloped, asymmetrically curling inward, with just a few thin fading violet wisps. The space between this shrinking energy membrane and the physical station's large aperture shows the neutral background through the open hole. Do not fill the original hole with a floor. The portal must look unequivocally smaller and collapsing, rather than merely bright or unstable at full size. Controlled storytelling with a few broken hull pieces attached to the structure, not a battle explosion.

RIGHT — CLOSED: same recognizable station, now a cold disabled wreck. Two major pylons are visibly sheared off, remaining ones are dark and badly damaged, shattered machinery is exposed, one quarter of the inner containment ring is breached and blackened, a broad section of port terrace has collapsed. ALL stabilizer coils, conduit lights and emitters are OFF. There is absolutely NO wormhole, NO violet spiral, NO blue disk, NO dark magical circle, NO residual glow and NO event horizon. The center is a literal empty mechanical hole: the SAME light gray studio background is plainly visible through it. The gateway did not close by a mechanical door: the passage through spacetime ceased to exist when the machinery was destroyed. Do not invent an iris, lid or solid plate covering the opening. Keep enough ruined Authority architecture to connect the wreck unmistakably with the two prior states.

STYLE: preserve the polished ivory/brass Art Deco industrial identity and refined hard-surface digital concept art of the input. Large understandable architecture, finely textured panels, soft neutral illumination. Damage is bent metal, broken housings and charred panels; no gore, no people. Empty space behind the hole must be clearly legible in the closed state.
No ships, enemies, weapons fire, starfield, planets, scenery, active explosions, huge smoke clouds, floating debris fields, interface, extra labels, logos or watermark. Keep all states visually readable and their differences unmistakable.
